instruction: Implement EVERY card in this pack. Clone from clone_path; match effect_text. Use duel_helpers.h. Spells: only edit the listed .c file. Traps: only edit listed trap .c. Do not leave TODO bodies. One make at the end of the whole batch.

cards.effect_text: GB: burn 500 per destroyed card. Activate only if you control a Gladiator Beast. If a card(s) is destroyed by battle or effect, its controller takes 500 per card.
Opp can only attack Gladiator Beasts. Activate only if you control a Gladiator Beast monster. Opp monsters cannot attack, except to attack Gladiator Beast monsters.
Tribute LS; negate Summon and destroy. When a monster(s) would be Summoned: Tribute 1 Lightsworn monster; negate the Summon, and if you do, destroy that monster(s).
Negate S/T while you control a GB. When an Effect Monster's effect is activated, if you control a face-up Gladiator Beast monster: Negate the activation and destroy it.
